metadata.datasource: Spectral sensitivity: Leica Monopan 50 Technische gegevens, juni 2025 (pm-23344, NL); https://leica-camera.com/sites/default/files/pm-23344-Leica-Monopan50_Technical-Data_nl.pdf; SHA256 81d55277de23b8a2fb2fe61674bae9c2612ed6afe85df53fe5ea708aeda2097f. Characteristic curve: ADOX HR-50 High Resolution Film, Technische Beschreibung, 20 Nov 2018 (ASC5011, EN), red curve (SPEED BOOST) in ADOX FX-39 1+9, 7 min 15 s, 20 C; https://www.macodirect.de/media/pdf/c2/97/cf/ASC5011_Datenblatt_e.pdf; SHA256 4ba8752ecaca593ec3bd2857024db659945f341284fb82e7a698e96c7c9b2998. Assumption: Monopan 50 is ADOX HR-50 (identical development table, gamma, reciprocity and spectral range); neither Leica nor ADOX states it. Unnumbered log E axis read as 0.5 per grid column (implied gamma 0.633, sheet gamma 0.65). Sensitivity PCHIP over 331.3-778.6 nm, null below the graph floor. Toe below D 0.20 and shoulder above D 1.49 are smooth continuations, not measurements. Reproduce with scripts/monopan/prepare.py; sources and checks in data/profile-sources/leica-monopan-50/.
